### What were you trying to do (and why)?

* dataspell
* goland

* rubymine

`ruby_source_checksum` looks like your most recent changes @Bo98

The Firefox cask supports multiple languages so we don't actually load it from the JSON API we load it from the source API. So it looks what's happening here is that we can't load it because we don't have any `sourcefile_path` because we don't actually have a file that corresponds to the cask at all. All we have is the source as text that we downloaded from the source API.

https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/blob/d7029e95cd888887ee80aaab0918c6a92ac81cad/Library/Homebrew/cask/cask_loader.rb#L233-L240

After loading the cask from the source API here we need to use the `source_checksum` from the JSON API to set `ruby_source_checksum` in the cask.
There are also many failed casks that do not support multiple languages. So I do not think that support for multiple languages is the cause of this problem.
Thanks for looking @apainintheneck! If you'd be able to braindump into a draft PR then I or Bo will finish it off. np if too late!

review_comments: Should this argument be made mandatory if things fail when it's not specified?

It is not mandatory if `sourcefile_path` is passed.

I don't really like the million parameters that `Cask`'s constructor can take so will see if there's anything better.
